entries.core_move: Apply the one-sided Laplace first-derivative property to replace $\mathcal{L}\{x'(t)\}$ with $sX(s)-x(0^-)$ in Laplace-domain signal and system equations.
Insert the appropriate pre-initial values into one-sided Laplace derivative formulas so initial conditions are carried correctly into $s$-domain equations.
Convert a second time derivative under the one-sided Laplace transform into $s^2X(s)-sx(0^-)-x'(0^-)$ for use in $s$-domain differential-equation models.
Transform a linear constant-coefficient differential equation into an algebraic equation in $s$ by applying one-sided Laplace derivative properties and carrying initial conditions.

entries.lesson_title: Impulses from Derivatives of Piecewise Signals
entries.core_move: Convert each jump discontinuity in a piecewise signal into a shifted impulse whose area equals the jump size when forming derivatives for Laplace-transform analysis.

entries.lesson_title: Using Derivatives to Transform Piecewise Linear Signals
entries.core_move: Transform a piecewise linear signal by differentiating it into simpler step and impulse terms, applying Laplace derivative properties, and solving algebraically for $X(s)$.
